question: schools under-delivering on applications - received less than 50 percent of what was expected, loose name matching (each application should count towards only its single best matching school)
gold_sql: WITH best AS (SELECT a."Applicant" AS applicant, o."School Name" AS matched_school, jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a."School")), lower(trim(o."School Name"))) AS sim FROM lpf_applications AS a JOIN lpf_outreach AS o ON jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(a."School")), lower(trim(o."School Name"))) >= 0.9 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a."Applicant" ORDER BY sim DESC, o."School Name") = 1) SELECT o."School Name", COUNT(b.applicant) AS applications_received, o."Applications Expected" FROM lpf_outreach AS o LEFT JOIN best AS b ON b.matched_school = o."School Name" GROUP BY o."School Name", o."Applications Expected" HAVING COUNT(b.applicant) < o."Applications Expected" / 2.0 ORDER BY o."School Name"

CURRENT QUESTION:
schools under-delivering on applications - received less than 50 percent of what was expected, loose name matching (each application should count towards only its single best matching school)
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH matched_schools AS (
  SELECT
    o."School Name" AS outreach_school,
    a."School" AS application_school,
    jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim(o."School Name")), lower(trim(a."School"))) AS similarity
  FROM "lpf_outreach" o
  LEFT JOIN "lpf_applications" a ON true
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o."School Name", a."School" ORDER BY similarity DESC) = 1
),
school_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(outreach."School Name", application_school) AS "School",
    SUM(outreach."Applications Expected") AS total_expected,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN similarity >= 0.9 THEN a."Applicant" END) AS actual_applications
  FROM "lpf_outreach" outreach
  LEFT JOIN matched_schools ON outreach."School Name" = matched_schools.outreach_school
  LEFT JOIN "lpf_applications" a ON matched_schools.application_school = a."School" AND matched_schools.similarity >= 0.9
  GROUP BY COALESCE(outreach."School Name", application_school)
)
SELECT
  "School",
  total_expected,
  actual_applications,
  (actual_applications * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_expected, 0)) AS "Percentage Delivered"
FROM school_stats
WHERE (actual_applications * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_expected, 0)) < 50
ORDER BY "Percentage Delivered" ASC;
```
